messages:
Maya: Quick ping 305: we need to coordinate a targeted base image rebuild to remediate CVE-glibc + a lingering libssh fix. Planning window: Thu 22:00 UTC. Who's available to own RBAC + keystore gating?
Jordan: I can take the RBAC piece. What's changing in the keystore path?
Maya: Keystore layout renames: `/keystore/signing/v1` -> `/keystore/supplychain/sign/v2`. That means service accounts reading signing metadata will need updated permissions.
Priya: Also adding `sbom-collector-sa` which will write SBOM bundles to the supplychain-audit topic. Need a producer ACL on the journal.
Asha: For signing we want the build-signer to only have asymmetric sign permission (no decrypt). On GCP that's `cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner`. Do we have a token broker for ephemeral grants?
sre-oncall: I'll be oncall during the cutover window. Please page me 15m before.
Jordan: We used the token-broker last quarter. Suggest flow: broker issues signed JWT grant to buildrunner, scoped to key:projects/*/cryptoKeys/supplychain-signing, TTL 20m, aud claim = keystore-broker.
Maya: Sounds good. Can we enforce MFA or approval step on prod signing?
Asha: We can add an approval webhook in the broker that calls a small lambda to check a PagerDuty approval; simplest is a manual approval step gated in the rollout doc.
sec-bot: [alert] Vulnerability tracker: CVE-2026-2110 (libssh) associated with image-base v1.4. Flagged for rebuild. Ticket SEC-3499 opened.
Priya: For RBAC updates I propose this ClusterRole snippet (will be checked into infra/roles/):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: supplychain-attest-reader
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["attestation.redwood.io"]
    resources: ["nodes/attestations"]
    verbs: ["get", "list"]
```
Jordan: Good. Add a ClusterRoleBinding for runtime-attest-sa only in the runtime namespaces, not cluster-wide. Use subject namespace selector.
Maya: Logging: please confirm supplychain-audit topic will have 10y retention and restricted to sec/audit group. We cannot mix it with user telemetry.
Priya: Confirmed. Separate topic, dedicated sink, retention 10y, ACLs: producers = build-runner-sa, sbom-collector-sa; readers = sec-audit-group.
Jordan: CI: adding an rbac-check job that queries the cluster for the binding and fails the PR if missing. Script: `scripts/check-rbac.sh` in repo.
Asha: Incident playbook note: if signing returns non-deterministic signature (sig mismatch), abort rollout, rotate to previous image tag, and open SEC-incident with severity P2. We should capture `keystore-access.log` and `broker-grants.log` for triage.
Maya: Good point. Also require SBOM artifacts to be uploaded and attested before canary. No canary without SBOM+attestation.
sre-oncall: I'll prepare the PagerDuty escalation policy. Also will run a synthetic after canary start: `curl -sS https://canary.internal/health | jq .` every 30s for 15m.
Jordan: One security nit: the builder image should not possess permanent credentials. Ensure the builder uses workload identity mapping and the broker issues short JWTs.
Priya: Sample broker call (example):
```
POST /v1/grant
{
  "sa": "build-runner-sa@redwood-inference",
  "key": "projects/redwood/cryptoKeys/supplychain-sign",
  "ttl": 1200
}
```
Response returns `jwt` and `signed_grant_id`. Record `signed_grant_id` to keystore-access.log.
sec-bot: [reminder] All keystore grants must be copied to /var/log/keystore-access.log and forwarded to splunk:audit immediately.
Maya: Timeline: Thu 21:00 preflight (RBAC apply dry-run, broker smoke), 22:00 bake+sign staging, 23:00 staging canary, Fri 00:30 prod cutover (subject to staging green).
Asha: I'll add a CI gate that rejects production promotion unless `sbom_present == true` and `attestation.status == PASSED`.
Jordan: I'll push RBAC PR in 15m. Maya, drop the rollout doc link and I'll add the preflight checklist.
Maya: Rollout doc: https://confluence.redwood/rollouts/rebuild-4301239999. Add approval step for prod signing.
Priya: After staging sign: run `keystore-audit.sh --since now-2h | grep 4301239999` and paste the high-level lines (mask key IDs).
Jordan: Any objections to using separate keys per region? I prefer regional keys to reduce cross-region access patterns.
Asha: Regional keys ok, but ensure the broker supports key aliasing so the bake doesn't care which region key it calls.
Maya: Ok. If no blockers, we'll execute the plan Thu. If signing fails in staging, rollback to image-base:v1.3.4 and escalate to SEC-IR.
Priya: Noted. I'll monitor logs during the bake and open SEC-3499 with triage notes if needed.
Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
